defective_pattern: Unscoped Multi-Section Markdown Injection and Collateral Section Destruction via unbounded wipes.
why_defective: Injecting multi-section markdown into a single DOM block destroys sequence. Unbounded deletions destroy sibling sections (e.g., Operational Definitions).
observed_symptoms: Chapter heading, problem statement, and conceptual definitions dumped into a single section.
Operational definitions missing after deleting Key Terms section.
corrective_remedy: Parse markdown into discrete sections. Inject strictly under canonical DOM headings. Delete specific sub-headings only.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting monolithic string replacements or bulk section deletions in DOCX revision scripts.
